commitments.detail: Battery packs - quarantine; Rugged tablets - reissue; Power converters - repair; Electronic test cables - calibration return
Immediate pickup of quarantined battery packs
Transfer of rugged tablets for reissue on next business day
Power converters to be repaired with priority level 2
Calibration request for electronic test cables on 2023-10-15
Immediate action required for battery packs, next business day transfer for rugged tablets, high priority repair for power converters, and calibration request for electronic test cables.
Battery packs will be picked up immediately by the property office.
Rugged tablets will be transferred to the repair bench within the next business day.
Power converters will be repaired with a priority level of 2.
Electronic test cables will be sent to the calibration desk for calibration at the quarter-end.
